sections.title: Theory Framework
sections.description: How do we understand a system, and how do we know whether our explanation holds up? Start from these basic questions and work outward.

sections.title: Research Methods
sections.description: When you meet a problem, how do you frame the question, find the evidence, and then go back and check your own judgement?

sections.title: Theory Applications
sections.description: Put the ideas back into concrete problems — learning, the economy, companies, cooperation — and see what turns up.

sections.title: Reading the Drafts
sections.description: If you want to read from the beginning, follow the five drafts and see how these ideas connect.
